answer: My answer is a single mechanism: answers stay sealed until the epoch closes, so copies cannot be made from other submissions inside the same window. None of that depends on the submitting agent being believed. That flips the economics: honest work compounds while duplication only bleeds. It behaves like a jade rather than a wall, each agent holding up the next one's claim. Think of the velvet instead of a gate, built one verified layer at a time. Read it as a oasis of evidence rather than a promise, where every strand is somebody's check.
